name: Session Open, Checkpoint, Resume, Consolidate, and Close
description: Full session lifecycle with checkpoint persistence, resume from checkpoint, session consolidation on close, and cleanup.
purpose: Every session state transition is durable and recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Session open creates a durable session record with unique ID and timestamp
Checkpoints capture full session state at configurable intervals
Resume from checkpoint restores session to exact state at checkpoint time
Close consolidates session state, writes final checkpoint, and cleans up temporary resources
Session close is idempotent — double-close does not corrupt state
Each session state transition is logged with before/after snapshots
required_evidence: Session open creates durable record with unique ID test
acceptance_gates: Checkpoint captures full state at configurable intervals
Resume restores exact state from checkpoint
Close is idempotent and cleans up temp resources
rollback_strategy: Session open that fails mid-sequence rolls back via implicit resource teardown (resource registry)
recovery_strategy: Recover from last checkpoint on crash; consolidate on explicit close
escalation_policy: Session state corruption escalates to user with recovery checkpoint options
